paragraphs: Met Éireann has a Status Yellow wind warning in place for Donegal and Mayo. It began at 5pm on Monday and lasts until 12 noon today, Tuesday 27 October. It comes just days after Storm Boelo, which left more than 23,000 homes in Donegal without power at the weekend.

Very strong and gusty southwest winds are expected. Loose objects may be blown around, driving and cycling may be difficult, and there could be large waves on the coast. Some trees and branches may fall.

At sea, gale force 8 winds are expected from Slyne Head to Malin Head and on to Carlingford Lough until midday, with another gale warning off the Mayo and Donegal coasts from 8pm to midnight. A small craft warning covers all Irish coasts until 8am on Wednesday.
Today will be blustery, with sunny spells and heavy showers, and possibly hail and thunder. Temperatures will be 8 to 12 degrees. Wednesday should be brighter and calmer.
People in the warning area should take care on the roads, stay away from exposed coasts and watch out for fallen trees and power lines.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭氣象局對多尼戈爾郡和梅奧郡發布了黃色強風警報。
警報從週一下午 5 點開始，持續到今天（10 月 27 日週二）中午 12 點。
就在幾天前，風暴博埃洛（Boelo）才在週末讓多尼戈爾郡超過 23,000 戶停電。
預計會有非常強勁、陣風明顯的西南風。
沒有固定的物品可能會被吹走，開車和騎自行車可能會很困難，海岸也可能出現大浪。
有些樹木和樹枝可能會倒下。
海上從斯萊恩角到馬林角，再到卡林福德灣，預計到中午前都會有 8 級大風；晚上 8 點到午夜，梅奧郡和多尼戈爾郡外海還有另一個大風警報。
小型船隻警報涵蓋愛爾蘭所有海岸，直到週三上午 8 點。
今天風勢強勁，有晴時和大陣雨，可能還有冰雹和雷聲。
氣溫為 8 到 12 度。
週三應該會比較晴朗、平靜。
警報區域內的民眾應注意道路安全，遠離空曠的海岸，並留意倒下的樹木和電線。

paragraphs: A Status Yellow wind warning issued by Met Éireann remains in force for Donegal and Mayo until 12 noon today, Tuesday 27 October. The warning, which came into effect at 5pm on Monday, was extended as unsettled weather continued in the wake of Storm Boelo.
Forecasters expect very strong and gusty south-westerly winds. Possible impacts include displaced debris, hazardous driving and cycling conditions, large coastal waves and some fallen trees.

Gale warnings are also in place at sea, with winds reaching gale force 8 between Slyne Head, Malin Head and Carlingford Lough until midday, and again off the Mayo and Donegal coasts between 8pm and midnight. A small craft warning applies to all Irish coastal waters until 8am on Wednesday.

The rest of Tuesday will be blustery, with sunny spells and scattered showers, some heavy, and the risk of isolated thunderstorms and hail. Highs will range from 8 to 12 degrees. Wednesday is expected to be mostly bright and milder.
People are advised to drive with care, avoid exposed coastal areas and report any fallen power lines to ESB Networks rather than approaching them.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭氣象局發布的黃色強風警報，在多尼戈爾郡和梅奧郡持續生效，直到今天（10 月 27 日週二）中午 12 點。
這項警報於週一下午 5 點生效，由於風暴博埃洛過後天氣持續不穩定而延長。
預報員預計會有非常強勁、陣風明顯的西南風。
可能的影響包括雜物被吹走、開車和騎車的危險路況、海岸大浪，以及部分樹木倒塌。
海上也發布了大風警報：斯萊恩角、馬林角和卡林福德灣之間的風力到中午前將達 8 級，晚上 8 點到午夜梅奧郡和多尼戈爾郡外海將再度出現大風。
小型船隻警報適用於愛爾蘭所有沿海水域，直到週三上午 8 點。
週二其餘時間風勢強勁，有晴時和零星陣雨，部分雨勢較大，局部地區還可能有雷雨和冰雹。
最高氣溫介於 8 到 12 度。
週三預計大致晴朗，氣溫較暖和。
民眾應小心駕駛，避開空曠的沿海地區，若發現掉落的電線，應通報 ESB Networks（電力公司），而不要靠近。

paragraphs: Donegal and Mayo remain under a Status Yellow wind warning from Met Éireann until noon today, Tuesday 27 October, as the unsettled spell that followed Storm Boelo lingers in the north-west. The alert took effect at 5pm on Monday and was subsequently prolonged.

Forecasters anticipate fierce, gusty south-westerlies capable of dislodging debris, making roads treacherous for motorists and cyclists, whipping up sizeable coastal waves and bringing down trees and branches.

At sea, gale force 8 winds are forecast between Slyne Head, Malin Head and Carlingford Lough until midday, with a further gale warning off the Mayo and Donegal coasts from 8pm until midnight. A small craft warning covers all Irish waters until 8am on Wednesday.

The remainder of the day will be blustery, interspersed with sunny intervals and heavy showers, with the odd thunderstorm and hail. Highs will be a modest 8 to 12 degrees before a brighter, milder Wednesday.
The public is urged to exercise caution on the roads, steer clear of exposed coastlines and keep well away from any downed power lines, reporting them to ESB Networks.
sentZh: 多尼戈爾郡和梅奧郡仍處於愛爾蘭氣象局發布的黃色強風警報中，直到今天（10 月 27 日週二）中午，因為風暴博埃洛過後的不穩定天氣仍在西北部徘徊。
這項警報於週一下午 5 點生效，隨後又延長。
預報員預計會有猛烈、陣風強勁的西南風，可能吹落雜物，讓道路對駕駛和騎士變得危險，掀起相當大的海岸浪潮，並吹倒樹木和樹枝。
海上預報斯萊恩角、馬林角和卡林福德灣之間到中午前會有 8 級大風，晚上 8 點到午夜梅奧郡和多尼戈爾郡外海還有另一波大風警報。
小型船隻警報涵蓋愛爾蘭所有水域，直到週三上午 8 點。
今天其餘時間風勢強勁，晴時與大陣雨交替，偶有雷雨和冰雹。
最高氣溫只有 8 到 12 度，之後週三會比較晴朗、溫和。
呼籲民眾在路上提高警覺，遠離空曠的海岸線，並與任何掉落的電線保持距離，向 ESB Networks（電力公司）通報。

paragraphs: A Status Yellow wind warning issued by Met Éireann remains in effect for counties Donegal and Mayo until 12 noon today, Tuesday 27 October. The warning commenced at 5pm on Monday and was subsequently extended, as unsettled conditions persisted following Storm Boelo.

Very strong and gusty south-westerly winds are anticipated. Consequently, the potential impacts include displaced debris, hazardous conditions for drivers and cyclists, substantial coastal waves and localised damage to trees.

Gale warnings are also in operation at sea, with winds expected to reach gale force 8 between Slyne Head, Malin Head and Carlingford Lough until midday, and again off the Mayo and Donegal coasts between 8pm and midnight. In addition, a small craft warning applies to all Irish coastal waters until 8am on Wednesday.

The remainder of Tuesday is forecast to be blustery, characterised by sunny spells and scattered heavy showers, together with a risk of isolated thunderstorms and hail. Maximum temperatures will range from 8 to 12 degrees, although Wednesday is predicted to be considerably brighter.
Members of the public are advised to drive cautiously, avoid exposed coastal areas and refrain from approaching fallen power lines, which should be reported to ESB Networks.

paragraphs: A Status Yellow wind warning issued by Met Éireann remains in force for Donegal and Mayo until 12 noon today, Tuesday 27 October. The warning, which came into effect at 5pm on Monday, was extended as unsettled weather continued in the wake of Storm Boelo.
Forecasters expect very strong and gusty south-westerly winds. Possible impacts include displaced debris, hazardous driving and cycling conditions, large coastal waves and some fallen trees.

Gale warnings are also in place at sea, with winds reaching gale force 8 between Slyne Head, Malin Head and Carlingford Lough until midday, and again off the Mayo and Donegal coasts between 8pm and midnight. A small craft warning applies to all Irish coastal waters until 8am on Wednesday.

The rest of Tuesday will be blustery, with sunny spells and scattered showers, some heavy, and the risk of isolated thunderstorms and hail. Highs will range from 8 to 12 degrees. Wednesday is expected to be mostly bright and milder.
People are advised to drive with care, avoid exposed coastal areas and report any fallen power lines to ESB Networks rather than approaching them.
